'''Verandala''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who held the position of Overseer at the [[Ulgo shipping facility]] in [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] [[King's Pass]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the facility was invaded by Republic-allied forces.<ref name="Mission" />
